tasks.prompt: A task verifiable against the skill TREE STRUCTURE (documented versions, reference file names, script inventories). Isolates the reduce-research goal.
tasks.notes: REQUIRED: cite the skill path holding the ground truth, e.g. skills/<domain>/<tech>/

tasks.prompt: A task verifiable against a FACT STATED INSIDE a skill file (feature, default, version change). Isolates the increase-accuracy goal. Verify the fact in the file when authoring.
tasks.notes: Use regex with \b word boundaries for short tokens to avoid substring collisions. Other grader types: exact, contains_any.
